verified_facts.claim: Iran was weeks from acquiring a weapon that would destroy Israel and the Middle East (according to Pastor Jeffress)
verified_facts.finding: The provided search results confirm that Pastor Robert Jeffress stated President Trump informed him and other faith leaders that Iran was within weeks of acquiring a weapon capable of destroying Israel and the Middle East. Jeffress shared this account following an Oval Office meeting regarding military action against Iran.

verified_facts.claim: Pastor Mark Burns dedicated a 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump
verified_facts.finding: Based on the provided search results, Pastor Mark Burns dedicated a 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump at Trump National Doral Miami in Florida. Burns defended the dedication against critics, stating that the monument was a celebration of life rather than an idol.

verified_facts.claim: 30 percent of Americans are against the Pope urging peace
verified_facts.finding: According to poll data reported across multiple sources, nearly one-third (30%) of surveyed Americans reacted negatively when asked about Pope Leo asking Americans to contact Congress to work for peace and reject war. Meanwhile, a two-thirds majority (66%) responded positively to the Pope's anti-war calls. The results confirm that 30 percent expressed opposition or negative sentiment toward the Pope's peace request.

verified_facts.claim: Darializa Avila Chevalier attended prayers at a mosque where the imam called for non-Muslims to be killed by the sword
verified_facts.finding: According to reporting by MEMRI, Darializa Avila Chevalier attended Friday prayers at the Al-Khoei Islamic Center in Queens, NY on March 6, 2026. During the prayer service, the imam led a supplication asking for relief for believers through the Mahdi and the killing of infidels by his sword.
